Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and swapped the birth years, attributing 1832 to P. J. O'Rourke and 1947 to José Echegaray y Eizaguirre, contradicting the WebSurfer’s correct sources (Wikipedia and Britannica). This inversion of dates led to the incorrect conclusion that O’Rourke was born first, when in fact Echegaray (1832) predates O’Rourke (1947).
